params.name: selector
params.description: Which piece of last-backup information to retrieve; selects the type/meaning of info1 and info2.

params.name: info1
params.description: First value associated with selector; concrete type/meaning depends on which selector constant was passed.

params.name: info2
params.description: Second value associated with selector; concrete type/meaning depends on which selector constant was passed.

overloads.semanticRole: Fills info1 and info2 with the piece of information about the last database backup selected by selector.

discriminatedBy.rule: The concrete type and semantic meaning returned in info1/info2 vary per selector constant (e.g. last backup date vs. duration vs. destination); see the 'Backup and Restore' theme constants.

constraints: selector must be one of the predefined constants from the "Backup and Restore" theme; the concrete type and meaning of info1 and info2 both depend on which selector constant is passed (e.g. one selector returns a Date in info1, another returns Integer).
